name: Heritage Jaysagar
why_it_matters: Lakeside restaurant on the northern shore of Joysagar Tank — the man-made lake commissioned by Ahom queen Madambika in the 18th century. Outdoor pier seating overlooks the same Ahom-era water that the Rang Ghar palace overlooks. 4.6 across 4,641 Justdial reviews. The only Sivasagar restaurant where you eat with the heritage view.
insider_tip: Sunset is the slot — arrive 5pm, order the duck curry, watch the swans on Joysagar. The boat ride (₹200/half-hour for the boat, not per person) is run by the restaurant. Pan-Asian menu is a distraction; stick to Upper Assamese here.

name: Maichang
why_it_matters: Sivasagar town's Assamese-ethnic option — first-floor seating above Corporation Bank on the main GNB Road. 'Minimum masala' style of cooking that lets the indigenous ingredients (ash gourd, ou tenga, bamboo shoot) lead. 3.6 across 76 Justdial reviews — modest, but the most-reviewed Assamese spot inside Sivasagar town as opposed to Joysagar.
insider_tip: Service is sometimes 45-60 minutes — order before sightseeing the Talatal Ghar / Rang Ghar, not after. Ask for the Assamese thali, not the multi-cuisine menu — the Indian-Chinese is forgettable.
signature_address: Above Corporation Bank, GNB Road, Sivasagar HO, Sivasagar, Assam 785640
